description: Windenergie Landkreis Rotenburg (Wümme) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Wind energy is an integral part of the energy supply. In addition to the presentations of the Regional Spatial Planning Programme 2020 "Wind Energy Use Priority Area", you will find all the locations of the existing, approved, but not yet commissioned and applied for wind turbines on the map. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Wind energy district Rotenburg (Wümme)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Bauamt, erneuerbar, Erneuerbare Energien, Anlage, regenerativ, Strom. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
